name: Caplin Point Laboratories Ltd
about: Caplin Point Laboratories Ltd is engaged in the manufacturing and sourcing of APIs, finished formulations, R&D, clinical research with presence in Latin America, Africa, USA and other nations.[1]
keyPoints: Business Overview:[1][2][3] Caplin Point makes and sells finished pharmaceutical formulations and APIs, and also runs R&D and clinical research. The group mainly serves Latin America, Africa, the US, and other regulated markets. Its portfolio has 5,000+ product registrations, 650+ formulations, 36 therapeutic segments, and 15+ dosage forms.
pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 21.4% CAGR over last 5 years
Company's median sales growth is 19.9% of last 10 years
